statement: Following reported exploitation of the PHP2Shell flaws, the CISA KEV catalog adds at least one entry whose vendorProject or product field contains PHP, with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-22 and 2026-11-05.
resolution: Fetch the CISA known exploited vulnerabilities JSON catalog after the deadline; true if any entry has vendorProject or product containing PHP and dateAdded from 2026-10-22 through 2026-11-05 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry with vendorProject or product containing PHP has a dateAdded value from 2026-10-22 through 2026-11-05.

statement: After disclosure of the CVSS 10.0 GitLab code execution flaw, the CISA KEV catalog adds at least one entry with vendorProject GitLab and a dateAdded value between 2026-10-22 and 2026-11-12.
resolution: Fetch the CISA known exploited vulnerabilities JSON catalog after the deadline; true if any entry has vendorProject equal to GitLab and dateAdded from 2026-10-22 through 2026-11-12 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry with vendorProject GitLab has a dateAdded value from 2026-10-22 through 2026-11-12.

statement: ICE front-month Brent crude futures settle above 125.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-20. Reference: 111.58 USD in the packet market snapshot dated 2026-10-22.
resolution: ICE Brent front-month daily settlement, as reported by Reuters or ICE, exceeds 125.00 USD on any trading day from 2026-10-23 through 2026-11-20 inclusive.
failure_condition: Every ICE front-month Brent daily settlement from 2026-10-23 through 2026-11-20 is at or below 125.00 USD.

statement: The NASDAQ Composite closes below 24,500 on at least one trading day between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-20. Reference: 26,099.07 in the packet market snapshot dated 2026-10-22.
resolution: The official NASDAQ Composite daily close, as shown by FRED series NASDAQCOM or Nasdaq data, is below 24,500 on any trading day from 2026-10-23 through 2026-11-20 inclusive.
failure_condition: Every NASDAQ Composite daily close from 2026-10-23 through 2026-11-20 is at or above 24,500.

statement: At its meeting on 2026-10-27 and 2026-10-28, the FOMC leaves the federal funds target range unchanged from the range in effect on 2026-10-22.
resolution: The Federal Reserve FOMC statement released on 2026-10-28 maintains the federal funds target range at its pre-meeting level; any increase or decrease makes the claim false.
failure_condition: The FOMC statement of 2026-10-28 announces any increase or decrease in the federal funds target range.

statement: At least one person is killed inside Saudi Arabia by a Houthi missile or drone attack occurring between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-05.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, AFP and BBC report one or more deaths inside Saudi Arabia from a Houthi missile or drone strike dated 2026-10-23 through 2026-11-05 inclusive.
failure_condition: No person is killed inside Saudi Arabia by a Houthi missile or drone attack occurring from 2026-10-23 through 2026-11-05.

statement: US or Israeli forces strike a target on Iranian soil between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, AFP and BBC report a US or Israeli air, missile or drone strike on a target on Iranian soil dated 2026-10-23 through 2026-11-30 inclusive; strikes on vessels at sea do not count.
failure_condition: No US or Israeli strike hits a target on Iranian soil from 2026-10-23 through 2026-11-30.

statement: Official delegations of Russia, Ukraine and the United States meet in person for trilateral negotiations between 2026-10-23 and 2026-12-04.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, AFP and BBC report that Russian, Ukrainian and US delegations met in person at one venue for negotiations dated 2026-10-23 through 2026-12-04; separate shuttle meetings do not count.
failure_condition: No in-person session with Russian, Ukrainian and US delegations at one venue takes place from 2026-10-23 through 2026-12-04.

statement: USGS lists an earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater, other than event us6000u43g, within 300 km of that event epicenter with origin time between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-05 UTC.
resolution: Query the USGS ComCat catalog after the deadline; true if any event other than us6000u43g with magnitude 6.0 or greater lies within 300 km of its epicenter with origin time 2026-10-23 through 2026-11-05 UTC.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater other than us6000u43g occurs within 300 km of its epicenter from 2026-10-23 through 2026-11-05 UTC.

statement: France declares a state of emergency covering any part of metropolitan France between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-12.
resolution: The Journal Officiel on Legifrance publishes a decree declaring a state of emergency under the 1955 law that covers any part of metropolitan France, dated 2026-10-23 through 2026-11-12 inclusive.
failure_condition: No decree declaring a state of emergency for any part of metropolitan France is issued from 2026-10-23 through 2026-11-12.
